name: List
summary: A vertical list of uniform rows — avatar + title/description meta and trailing actions, with size, bordered and split options, and an opt-in single-choice picker mode.
highlights: Avatar, title and description meta, trailing actions
Opt-in picker: selectable rows, select event, keyboard
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-list> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Feed it structured rows via `items` (each { title, description?, avatar?, actions? } lays out a leading avatar, a title + description meta block, and a trailing actions cluster), or drop light-DOM children for plain free-form rows. Config: `size` (small · default · large row padding), `bordered` (outer container border), `split` (row dividers, on by default), `list-title` (header), `footer`, and a `loading` skeleton. Rows highlight on hover when interactive; the last row drops its divider. Add `selectable` to make the `items` rows a single-choice picker: a listbox of role="option" rows with aria-selected, click or Enter/Space to select, arrow keys, Home and End to move, one tab stop with a focus ring; `value` names the selected row's `key`, and the list emits a composed `select` with { key, index }. Without `selectable` nothing changes. Zero drift — the same element, not two look-alikes. Emits a composed `action`, and `select` in picker mode.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin ref wrapper that listens for `action` (and `select` in picker mode); Vue binds the custom element natively. The primitive is defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

spec.label: Row
spec.value: padding 12/20 (small 8, large 16) · 14/22 #4A4A4A · avatar 36 + meta + trailing actions

spec.label: Action
spec.value: 28px icon button, text-tertiary #8A8A8A; danger hover error-tinted

spec.label: Split
spec.value: row dividers #F1F1F1, on by default; split=false drops them

spec.label: Row hover
spec.value: interactive rows → bg #F7F7F7, motion-fast ease-out (persistent node)

spec.label: Selected row
spec.value: selectable only → bg-accent #E70E680D (the Menu's selected tint), hover keeps the tint; pointer cursor

spec.value: selectable only → 2px border-focus #E70E68 ring inset 2px on :focus-visible, one tab stop (roving)

props.name: items
props.desc: Structured rows: { key?, title, description?, avatar? (icon name), selected?, actions?:[{ key, icon, danger?, label? }] }. `key` and `selected` matter only with `selectable`

props.name: (children)
props.desc: Free-form fallback — each light-DOM child renders as one plain row (used when `items` is empty)

props.name: split
props.desc: Row dividers; set split="false" to remove them

props.name: loading
props.desc: Show shimmer skeleton rows in place of content

props.name: selectable
props.desc: Picker mode for `items` rows: role=listbox, rows role=option with aria-selected, click or Enter/Space selects, ArrowUp/ArrowDown/Home/End move focus. Light-DOM rows are not selectable

props.name: value
props.desc: With `selectable`: the selected row's `key` (a row without `key` answers to its index as a string). Set by the list on select; setting it re-marks rows without rebuilding. Unset → the first row with `selected: true`

props.name: select
props.desc: With `selectable`: composed event when a row is picked (click, Enter or Space), detail { key, index }. Fires after `value` is set; an action button click does not select

props.name: action
props.desc: Composed event on a trailing action click, detail { key, index }

whenToUse.when: many uniform rows of the same shape (recent items, participants, feeds)
multi-column records that need sorting or alignment
one titled group of mixed content
pick one row from a list of rich rows (a survey, deck or template picker)
pick one value from a short list of plain labels in a compact control

opinion.note: Keep rows to one shape — a title, optionally a description and a small trailing actions cluster. Reserve `bordered` for a standalone list; drop the border when the list sits inside a card. For dense multi-column data reach for the Table instead.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — DS V3's measured set has no dedicated data-List container cell (search returns only list icons + the distinct Upload List Item primitive); the matrix follows antd List conventions over the DS token layer: size (small/default/large row padding), bordered (outer border), split (row dividers), optional header/footer, item content = optional avatar + title/description meta + trailing actions, and a loading state. Tokens: white surface, border #E3E3E3, split #F1F1F1, radius-lg 12, bg-accent avatar, color-primary glyph, color-error danger action, text-default/secondary/tertiary. Motion bound to the shared motion tokens on persistent nodes. A deliberate, documented extension — not a measured match.
